highlights.reason_zh: 新规会改变 gateway、router 与模型市场的供应商接入边界，但 11 月 20 日才生效。
highlights.reason_en: The policy changes vendor-access boundaries for gateways, routers and model marketplaces, but takes effect November 20.

highlights.reason_zh: Apache-2.0 权重与 Ollama/vLLM 路径让本地 coding model 可以立即做受控对比。
highlights.reason_en: Apache-2.0 weights and Ollama/vLLM paths make a controlled local coding-model comparison possible now.

highlights.reason_zh: 持久 receipt 与 UNKNOWN 结果把重启后的副作用恢复变成可测试契约。
highlights.reason_en: Durable receipts and UNKNOWN outcomes make post-restart side-effect recovery a testable contract.

highlights.reason_zh: 逐工具安全遥测和幂等 MCP 重试直接改善 coding agent 的可审计性。
highlights.reason_en: Per-tool safety telemetry and idempotent MCP retry directly improve coding-agent auditability.

highlights.reason_zh: 全球嵌入与完整公开产物可直接试验，但自定义许可会改变可用范围。
highlights.reason_en: Global embeddings and complete public artifacts are testable now, while the custom license materially limits use.

coverage_zh: 35/36 个固定入口直接抓取并读完；Codex feed 空响应后改用官方 Releases 页面恢复核验，仅见 alpha。主动检索覆盖小团队、开放权重、非英语材料、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。发布方 benchmark 均标明待独立验证；TorchNeuron 访问阶段存在官方表述冲突。
coverage_en: 35 of 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed directly; the empty Codex feed was recovered through the official Releases page, which showed alpha builds only. Active discovery covered small teams, open weights, non-English material, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Publisher benchmarks remain marked for independent validation; TorchNeuron has conflicting official access-stage language.
